description: Utility functions and setup code for testing Fastify server with Vitest, including request wrappers, database index setup, mock data seeding, and date serialization.

methods.name: getCsrfToken
methods.description: Extracts CSRF token from set cookies.

methods.name: getCookies
methods.description: Concatenates cookies into a single string for request headers.

methods.name: superRequest
methods.description: Wrapper around supertest to handle common request setup including headers, cookies, and CSRF token.

methods.name: createSuperRequest
methods.description: Factory function to create pre-configured superRequest functions with specific method and cookies.

methods.name: checkCanConnectToDb
methods.description: Checks database connectivity by counting user records with a timeout.

methods.name: setupServer
methods.description: Initializes Fastify server, sets up database indexes, and manages test lifecycle hooks.

methods.name: resetDefaultUser
methods.description: Resets mock user data in the database.

methods.name: devLogin
methods.description: Performs a mock login to obtain session cookies.

methods.name: seedExam
methods.description: Seeds mock exam data into the database.

methods.name: createFetchMock
methods.description: Creates a mock fetch function returning specified response.

methods.name: serializeDates
methods.description: Recursively converts Date objects to ISO string format while preserving data shape.
